scope: New exact rational/interval checks for degree-one trace constants, nonpositive one-coordinate degree-two coefficient, and one-coordinate repeated positive-envelope budget. These are original-kernel coefficient statements, not actual FIRST samples or an endpoint proof.
positive_exp_interval: Exact positive Taylor lower sum, with first omitted term divided by 1-q/(M+2) as upper remainder; M=4*ceil(q)+64. Negative exp obtained by reciprocal endpoint reversal.
new_checks: one-coordinate degree-two coefficient <=0 including r=0 endpoint
degree-m positive coefficient bounded by t/n^(m-1) for 3<=m<=n+2
exact geometric positive envelope finite sum and remaining infinite tail equals t/(n-1)
rational constants 1113/64<18 and short-degree budget factor at J=floor(sqrt(n)/2)
independent finite positive Markov algebra for Q^j u and original exterior trace, not simulated original kernels
failure_policy: Save failed residuals and exit nonzero. No unregistered search, fitting, or silent retry.
